dedupe_keys.name: city of melbourne floor space demand forecasts by small area 2023 2043

description: City of Melbourne publishes floor space demand forecasts in square metres by single year from 2023 to 2043, prepared by SGS Economics and Planning between February and September 2024, for the municipality and its small areas, by industry and by type of space use. Coverage: the City of Melbourne municipality and its small areas, Australia; forecasts for 2023 to 2043, about 9,300 rows, record last modified on 2026-09-03. Format and access: CSV, JSON, downloadable without registration from the City of Melbourne open data portal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY; cost: free. Caveats: forecasts by consultants for planning, not observed floor space; the dataset id still carries the older 2020-2040 label. Simulation uses: future building-stock and floor-space scenarios for demand on transport, energy and water systems, and for city growth models. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
name: City of Melbourne: floor space demand forecasts by small area, 2023-2043
